message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts: burglary (entering house by breaking window) and theft of cash and phone. In Chinese criminal law, this is "盗窃" (theft). Also the act of breaking into a house could be "入户盗窃" which is still theft. No other crimes like robbery (抢夺) because no violence. So charge: 盗窃.

Thus final answer: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>.
